title: Baseline and frame census
gate: re/roadmap/BASELINE.md holds the current numbers of every regression gate; port/test/framegate.py runs every checkpoint of the 64 pinned scenarios with the gfx backend and LiveTerrain attached and writes re/roadmap/frame_census.tsv (scenario, checkpoint, status PASS / FAIL <px by region> / UNSUPPORTED <first call> / NOT_RUN <boot status>, terrain on screen yes / no); causes ranked by checkpoints blocked
notes: starts after the P5.3 session's handoff commit (see ROADMAP_ORCHESTRATOR.md rules); one lead slot is kept for it until it starts

title: Phase 4 and phase 3 loose ends
gate: each of U-1066 (tutorial pages 1..29, the theme screen's Cancel, palette groups 21 / 22), U-1067 (recorder rejects input with no DELIVER), U-1051 (input during a world load), U-1032 (bio entry), U-1012 (strictFlagSticky), U-1060 (readers of the header bytes past the NUL) resolved, or kept open with a measured reason; segment and boot gates unchanged or extended by the new scenarios

title: 2D screens
needs_game: only for a screen no pinned checkpoint shows
gate: every census checkpoint with no terrain on screen PASS (0 px in every region), one negative control RED per new body; segment and boot gates unchanged
notes: steps = the census causes; one screen family per worker (difficulty, theme packs, load browser, pick a pro, credits, hire, reports F1-F10, character editor, preferences, bulletin board, popups, scroll text)

title: In-game frame
gate: every census checkpoint with terrain on screen: the 2D layers 0 px, the terrain region within the U-1076 criterion (max(2 %, 0.4 % x median rho) one-level, 0 beyond one level); FLIC sprite cells, the sprite queue, golfers and ball, HUD panels, ticker text with markup, cursor and tooltip (U-1069, U-1072), overlay lines (U-1071)
notes: terrain steps continue from the P5.3 session's handoff; FLIC decoding lives here (loadWorldAssets' 114..120 loads are sprite animations)

title: Audio engine model (no recordings)
needs_game: no (fixtures replay the C3 / C4 evidence; a game run only to re-check a hook's own A/B)
gate: the port's audio module (sound.dll's engine: sound objects, channels, sequencer, the Snd interface the exe calls, the mixer with the X80 method where the original sets 0x0f7f, WAV / MMIO loading over GameFiles, the LPC-10 codec) behind an AudioSink; each ported function equals its C3 / C4 path-1 rows replayed as port/test/test_bridge.py does (return and compared-region hashes), x64 and Win32; the exe's sound calls in the segments produce an AudioSink command stream with every segment digest unchanged
notes: D3: recordings of the original's audio output are postponed; the output-device question comes back when they are planned

title: Text without GDI
gate: a FreeType rasteriser (system library, D4) of the game's fonts compared with the GDI provider on the 11,459 recorded widths and every recorded label pixel: equal, or the measured difference reported to Mariano; the port's default stays GDI until he decides

title: Defect decisions
gate: re/port/defect_decisions.tsv: every row of re/port/divergences.tsv and re/analysis/data/model_defects.md with its effect (save, balance, sim state, frame, hang, fault), a recommendation and the switch; a `fixed` profile that fixes the hang and fault defects (D5: pre-approved) and nothing else; the defects whose fix changes a save, balance, the sim state or a frame listed for Mariano; the `original` profile leaving every gate unchanged

title: Playable host (Windows)
gate: port/app: a Windows executable from the user's install (window, real mouse and keyboard as root-handler commands, real-time frame pacing, the gfx back buffer and the terrain raster presented, GDI text, movies skipped per D2); an input recording made through the app replays in the boot gate to equal per-frame sim hashes; Mariano plays title menu -> sandbox -> one hole; audio out after S4, a non-Windows host after S5

title: Video (skip path)
gate: every Bink movie the game plays listed with its call site, a documented skip path the port takes for each (D2), tested from boot with the intro on; FLIC cutscenes outside S3, if any, drawn or listed
